context:
Goal: a PR that ends up editing only docs, after a review round, can post its record and merge.
Problem (rule): a docs-only record has zero rounds, so after an earlier round on the same PR the restart check reads zero as a lower top round and refuses it; allowing it changes two decisions, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): decision pr-review-record refuses a record whose top round is below the earlier top round; the lane's test-author showed the refusal on main 8d7d36bd9.
Based on (read): decision docs-only-prs-skip-review gives a docs-only PR zero review rounds.
Departs from: main refuses a docs-only record after any earlier round — option a lets it post when its kind is docs-only and no guard or check changed, and every changed file is a doc.

options.gain: A PR that turns docs-only after a review posts and merges with no filler round.
options.how: The review-record check accepts a docs-only record after an earlier round only when the record says no guard or check changed and the PR's diff touches docs alone. A lane builds it, red test first, and rewrites both decisions in place. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Allow a docs-only record after an earlier round
options.lose: The shared check accepts a record it refuses today; a lane could try docs-only to step past a failed round, and only the docs-only diff check stops that.

options.gain: The record rule stays one rule, and the check accepts nothing new.
options.how: Nothing changes; the step closes. Such a PR posts a normal record with one more real round.
options.label: Keep the refusal (recommended)
options.lose: One filler review round, with its tokens and wait, for a PR that only edits docs.

reply: Closed 09:24 CST Nov 13 by triage: your past ruling settles it. Decision docs-only-prs-skip-review (owner 2026-09-26 and 2026-11-04 07:56 CST) gives a docs-only PR no review at all. Its review record is Kind: normal with a Round line, never docs-only. So a PR that already had a round keeps its normal record and posts no docs-only record. Option b stands: the refusal stays, and step docs-only-record-after-round is dropped. Undo: reopen this item.
short: Docs-only record after a review round

shown.label: Allow a docs-only record after an earlier round

title: May a docs-only PR that already had a review round post a docs-only record and merge?
why: It changes what the review record accepts, which two decisions set.
